lines: - Nightcap: "Oh, that. Yeah, uh, that's The Prince. Or will be if we can manage to grow it. Needs Fergolyte. But that's rare in The Deepmines these days I tell ya. I ain't been able to find any of that since well, oof, I don't remember. Some say The Prince, makes you dream funny. I say that's just nonsense."
- Nightcap: "Don't listen to that trash, mate. Corporate just wants a little fungal remediation, is'all. Get in. Get out. Get paid. Easy credits."
- Nightcap: "Right? Something messing with our gear? Sure you ain't been snacking on these mushrooms, mate?"
- Nightcap: "Job sure would be easier if these mushrooms weren't so mucking pretty to look at."
- Nightcap: "Watch the spores! Get back to the airlock you MUCKERS! Run! What the hell is that??"
- Nightcap: "Hey. For Sol's sake who let a mucking kid down here? Hey! Get back here. Stop mucking about with our gear."
- Nightcap: "You little mucker. You dumped me muckin' accelerant. Huh, smart little mucker."
- Nightcap: "No corporate. No co. Nokko. I'm gonna call you Nokko."
- Nightcap: "All this fungi... I swear it's filtering the waste from the towers. You take the fungi away and Venus goes all fire and brimstone."
- Nef Anyo: "It has come to my attention that some Solaris are refusing work orders in the deepmines. Such insubordination will be dealt with swiftly."
- Nightcap: "No. Mr. Anyo, sir! I will not comply. I'm shutting down the elevator. Nothing more goes up and nothing more comes down."
- Nightcap: "Well look at you, Nokko. You ain't some leftover freak that some Orokin mucker made in a lab. Don't know how or why, but somewhere along the line you became the roots and fruits."
- Nef Anyo: "I should have never sent Solaris to do the job of Corpus."
- Nightcap: "I'm blowing the mineshaft. No more coming in. No more getting out."
- Nightcap: "Just you and me now, kid."
- Nightcap: "Okay. Nokko. Your garden is safe."
- Nightcap: "It's getting dark, Nokko. I don't think I can help you much longer."

- Nightcap: "You're trying to tell me, that I, good old Nightcap, died down here ages ago? Haha. You better be careful, The Prince can play tricks on you. He's a funny fella, just like Nokko. But you gotta keep your head on straight. Trust me, you ain't careful, this place will turn you all sorts funny."
- Nightcap: "You need to sit down? You look a bit wobbly."
- Nightcap: "So... Learn anything? Or is that all nonsense?"
- Nightcap: "Like I said, nothing to it. Now, you wanna get back out to the garden?"

path: Interacting When The Prince Is Hungry
lines: - Nightcap: "I reckon our little Prince over there is a bit famished. He'd love some Fergolyte, if you've got some."
- Nightcap: "Hear that? Guess you don't. Our prince is telling you he's hungry again."
- Nightcap: "I think The Price is ready for more some Fergolyte if you can get your mitts on some."
